package android.content
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import java.io.File
open class Context(val filesDir: File) {
    val packageName = "com.dsh.android"
    class AppInfo(val uid: Int = 0)
    val applicationInfo = AppInfo()
    val contentResolver = ContentResolver()
    var foregroundStarts = 0
    var rejectForeground = false
    fun startService(intent: Intent): Any? = error("Validation must use foreground service")
    fun startForegroundService(intent: Intent): Any? { if (rejectForeground) error("Foreground start rejected"); foregroundStarts++; return Any() }
    fun stopService(intent: Intent) = true
    fun sendBroadcast(intent: Intent, permission: String) {}
}
class ContentResolver {
    var callback: (String, Bundle) -> Bundle? = { _, _ -> null }
    var calls = 0
    fun call(uri: Uri, method: String, arg: String?, extras: Bundle): Bundle? { calls++; return callback(method, extras) }
}
class Intent {
    var action: String? = null
    constructor()
    constructor(value: String) { action = value }
    constructor(context: Context, cls: Class<*>)
    fun setAction(value: String): Intent { action = value; return this }
    fun setClassName(pkg: String, cls: String) = this
    fun setPackage(pkg: String) = this
    fun putExtra(key: String, value: String) = this
    fun addFlags(flags: Int) = this
    companion object { const val FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK=1; const val FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP=2 }
}
